tasks.description: Выполнить вычисления, чтобы определить, сколько лет потребовалось для изменения процента на 13%.

result.python_code:
# Initial percentage of women in computer science in 1995
initial_percentage = 37

# Percentage of women in computer science in 2017
percentage_2017 = 24

# Calculate the change in percentage
percentage_change = initial_percentage - percentage_2017

# Years between 1995 and 2017
years_passed = 2017 - 1995

# Calculate the average annual change in percentage
average_annual_change = percentage_change / years_passed

# Calculate the number of years required for the percentage to change by 13%
required_change = 13
required_years = required_change / average_annual_change

# Print the final answer clearly
print(f'Количество лет, необходимых для изменения процента на 13%: {required_years:.2f} лет')
